req.title: Task title max length
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title exceeds the maximum length constraint.

doc.reasoning: The schema defines title as max_length=100 (TaskBase). Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — valid title well within limit; (2) negative EP — title clearly over 100 chars returns 422; (3) BVA at exactly 100 chars (boundary, should succeed with 201); (4) BVA at 101 chars (boundary+1, should fail with 422); (5) BVA at 99 chars (boundary-1, should succeed with 201). This covers both sides of the max_length=100 boundary to catch off-by-one mutations (100->99, 100->101), comparison-operator mutations, and validates the exact HTTP status codes on both success and error paths.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201
preconditions: Database is initialised with pre-loaded rows
actions: POST /tasks/ with a title of 50 characters (well within max_length=100)
expected: Response body contains the submitted title exactly
trace: R-TASK-029: valid title must not trigger 422
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201():
    title = "A" * 50
    payload = {"title": title, "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == title
    assert body["completed"] == False

test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201()
